before: /* ── SYMBOLS: one size for the characters used as pictures (close ×, star, drop-zone and empty-state marks) ── */
/* ── SPACING: margin, padding, gap and offsets ── */
/* ── GLYPHS: optical sizes of icons, dots, checkmarks, carets and separators ── */
/* ── OPACITY: the number is the percentage ── */
/* ── CONTROLS: sizes (value in the name; controls only) ── */
/* breakpoints: read by the shell's JavaScript (CSS media queries cannot read custom properties; grid.css repeats them) */
/* ── CONTROLS: visual size inside a larger target, and target sizes ── */
/* ── LAYOUT: gutters and page margins (density picks one; see density ── */
/* ── LAYOUT: content max-widths (prose, forms, record detail, editors, very wide workspaces) ── */
